page: Microsoft Azure NC144ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the NCdsRTXPRO6000BSEv6XL family. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 144 dedicated vCPUs and is configured with 516.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.58 GB of RAM per core.

For storage-intensive and high-throughput workloads, this server is equipped with 7921 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable. It also integrates a single GPU, as indicated by its hardware classification. This combination of high-capacity local storage, dense compute resources, and dedicated graphics acceleration supports demanding data processing tasks.

Given its hardware profile, the instance is structured for workloads requiring substantial parallel processing, large local datasets, and GPU acceleration. Suitable applications include data science pipelines, machine learning model training and inference, 3D rendering, and large-scale database operations.
